'''Sim'char'ser''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It received shipments of [[Roonstone]]s from the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of [[Quilken/Legends|Quilken]].
